The '''Rennek palace''' was the seat of power of [[Zeta Magnus]], self-anointed [[King/Legends|sovereign]] of the [[Dark Worlds]], at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was an opulent building, notably housing a jewel-encrusted [[Throne/Legends|throne]] of [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]] and a [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] center within its throne room. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Magnus stayed at the [[Rennek (celestial body)|Rennek]] palace while an accelerated transgenic [[Zeta Magnus (clone)|decoy]] of himself tried to take control of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Skye/Legends|Skye]]. When the decoy was ultimately [[Battle of Skye|defeated]] by three [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Magnus' [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Blue-Tark/Legends|Blue-Tark]] returned to the palace to report to her master. An [[Zeta Magnus's clone army|army]] of [[Sun Guard]] clones were held in [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]] in hundreds of [[Cloning tank|cloning cylinders]] located in the Rennek palace throne room.

==Behind the scenes==
Rennek spelled backwards is "[[Kenner Products|Kenner]]," the company behind the aborted, ''[[The Epic Continues]]'' in which the "Dark Worlds" originated.
